cases.case_label: SVA_E ~1.2 kb downstream of GNAS exon XL
cases.mechanism_detail: A maternally inherited ~2.8-kb SVA_E inserted ~1,200 bp telomeric (downstream) of GNAS exon XL segregates with loss of methylation at the exon A/B DMR in six affected relatives. Authors propose that AATAAA signals at the SVA 3' end truncate the maternal NESP transcript, preventing re-establishment of A/B methylation in oogenesis (not directly tested).
cases.quote: The retrotransposon most likely causes the observed epigenetic defect by impairing function of a maternally derived NESP transcript, consistent with findings in mice lacking full-length NESP mRNA and in PHP1B patients with deletion of exon NESP and adjacent intronic sequences.
